item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the gate command and result, the base arm, three negative-control logs (neg1.log, neg2.log, repair_neg.log), representative_state_tokens base 2082 / head 2167 under the 2200 ceiling, and the repaired byte-bound deviation under follow_ons.
